name: TameGirl
source:
Main character works with cat-girl maid waitresses Aka and Ai. Protagonist may choose to pursue any of them. The ending will depend on the choices during night time changing "sensitivity" and "pleasure" parameters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与猫女女服务员阿嘉和爱一起工作。主角可以选择追求其中任何一个。结局将取决于夜间改变“敏感性”和“愉悦”参数的选择。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
